notes: «جدتي خديجة بنت حمدان» : «جدتي» is dropped, the surface is the name alone (rule 7)
The Imam Rida enters the story but does not speak in it: he is in the scene, not a link (rule 6)

The editorial closing «[والسّلام على من اتّبع الهدى]» and the number «1 -» are left out
